title: Project: Build a Complete Web Page Using HTML
description: Apply your knowledge of HTML to create a complete and well-structured web page.

flashcards.question: Which HTML element represents the main content area of a web page?
What is the purpose of the `<header>` element?
flashcards.answer: To contain introductory content or navigational links.

flashcards.question: Which element is used to group related sections or content on a page?
How do you create a hyperlink in HTML?
flashcards.answer: Using the `` tag with the `href` attribute, e.g., `Link Text`.

flashcards.question: Which tag should be used to add an image to a webpage?
flashcards.answer: The `` tag, with the `src` attribute specifying the image URL.

flashcards.question: Why is the `alt` attribute important for images?
flashcards.answer: It provides alternative text for accessibility and displays if the image fails to load.

flashcards.question: What is the role of the `<footer>` element?
flashcards.answer: It defines the footer section of a document or a section.

flashcards.question: How do you add a comment in HTML?
Which element defines a self-contained, independent piece of content?
What HTML element is used to create a form for user input?
